[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=77"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "gene-annotation-episode"
version = "0.2.0"
description = "Controlled iterative biological annotation through method_loop"
requires-python = ">=3.11"
dependencies = ["biopython>=1.85,<2", "jsonschema>=4.23,<5", "numpy>=2,<3", "scipy>=1.14,<2", "pyrodigal>=3.7,<4", "pyhmmer>=0.12,<0.13", "requests>=2.32,<3", "Pillow>=11,<13"]

[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = ["pytest>=8,<10"]

[project.scripts]
gene-episode = "gene_annotation_episode.cli:main"

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
include = ["gene_annotation_episode*", "method_loop*"]
exclude = ["tests*", "_superseded*"]

[tool.setuptools.package-data]
gene_annotation_episode = ["defaults.toml", "vendor/*.txt", "vendor/*.json", "vendor/LICENSE*", "knowledge/*.json", "knowledge/*.md", "launch_instruction_library/*.json", "launch_instruction_library/*.md", "bvbrc_application_specs/MANIFEST.json", "bvbrc_application_specs/original/*.json", "bvbrc_application_specs/derived/*.json", "bvbrc_application_specs/README.md", "bvbrc_appservice_schemas.json", "bvbrc_proteome_native_schemas.json", "bvbrc_proteome_data_schemas.json", "bvbrc_proteome_sheet_schemas.json"]
method_loop = ["LICENSE", "SOURCE.json", "LOCAL_PATCHES.json"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]
